posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-remote 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web 远程访问网关：登录鉴权 + 到本机服务的 HTTP/WebSocket 反向代理，无需 --trusted-host。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7c9833e40c0866eeb37d.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-remote is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Remote access gateway for the DSH Web GUI: login auth plus an HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy to the loopback server, no --trusted-host needed.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7c9833e40c0866eeb37d.html
